purpose: Authoritative top-level admission policy joining maintenance/return-to-service evidence to family-specific route safety. A favorable route calculation may not erase a blocking maintenance state, and machinery condition may not select transit family.

designIntentSource.title: The different lightspeed methods
designIntentSource.role: Governing design intent for differentiated FTL hazards, gravity sensitivity, predictive sensing, emergency de-transit, maturity-scaled safety, and technical depth.

admissionOrder: resolve maintenance evidence when required or supplied
validate maintenance evidence freshness when an explicit validity interval is supplied
block on maintenance BLOCKED or CONFLICT
block as UNRESOLVED when required maintenance evidence is absent or unresolved
combine results conjunctively so neither side can average away the other
downgrade otherwise-ADMISSIBLE route results when maintenance certification is conditional

implicitTriggers: technologyAdapter supplied for a service/re-certification request
maintenanceRequirement.noTriggerBehavior: Route safety may proceed using existing installation timing/readiness authority; no recent maintenance event is invented.

conjunctivePolicy: Any BLOCK state produces REJECTED admission.
Required UNRESOLVED evidence produces UNRESOLVED admission.
A conditional maintenance state downgrades an otherwise ADMISSIBLE route to MARGINAL.
A route MARGINAL state remains MARGINAL even when maintenance is CERTIFIED.
SIMULATION_ONLY can never become operationally ADMISSIBLE.

freshnessPolicy.validityRule: When maintenanceEvidenceValiditySeconds is explicitly supplied, age greater than the validity interval makes required maintenance evidence UNRESOLVED.
freshnessPolicy.safeguard: No universal certificate lifetime is invented. Omitted validity remains governed by the underlying technology/service authority.

physicalSafeguards: Maintenance health is not route-environment health.
Route-environment safety is not proof of machinery health.
Stored energy adequacy is distinct from instantaneous power delivery adequacy.
Reachable infrastructure is distinct from timely infrastructure and both are distinct from certification.
PRECOMMIT families use prediction/intervention timing rather than fabricated local FTL velocity.
Anchored portal systems use admission, synchronization, aperture/throat, exit, clearance, and recovery semantics rather than free-flight velocity.
Species or technology basis never selects FTL family.

raceTechnologySafeguards.arnock: Default to solid-state electromechanical modular machinery, silicon computation, and piezoelectric diagnostics. Biotechnology remains secondary unless a narrower source establishes an exception.
raceTechnologySafeguards.zwleiMurrek: Preserve field-vane, dielectric-fluid, hydraulic, bio-reactive power-fluid, coolant, Navigation Current, and sensor evidence without normalizing the source term 'gravitic slipstream' into a consolidated family.

provenanceRule: The route-admission packet must retain the complete maintenance packet, the complete route-safety result, authority references, warnings, and the reason for any disposition downgrade or block.
